title: Ochomogo War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Ochomogo War", at revision 1372904988, opens: "The Ochomogo War was a civil war fought in Costa Rica, the first in its history, and was fought shortly after the country became independent from Spain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16573164, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1823 civil war in Costa Rica". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
